messages.subject: Normal Distribution ordered or not?
parts:
Hello!

I have a simple question.

The elements in the vector b[J, K] has the follow distributions:
b[j,1] ~ Normal(0, 2)
b[j, (k+1)] ~ Normal(0, 2)I(b[j, k])

where the notation I(b[j, k]) indicates that the threshold b[j, (k+1)] was sampled to be larger than b[j, k].

I want to know if the Stan code below is right? If not, what is the right code?


parameters {
  ...
  ordered[K] b[J];
  ...
}
model {
  ...
  for (j in 1:J)
    b[j] ~ normal(0, 2);
  ...
}

Thanks,
Marcelo

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Normal Distribution ordered or not?
parts:
I didn't understand your I notation --- is that a carryover
for BUGS/JAGS that's missing a comma?

What this

> ordered[K] b[J];

does is make sure that b[j,1] < b[j,2] < ... < b[j,K]
for all j. And it gets an implicit improper uniform prior
over all b meeting the constraint.

- Bob
